verdict.rationale: Bun's package manager is a local CLI that installs npm packages. The pack documents no hosted service or account that holds user data, so vendor-side data retention and deletion controls are a category mismatch for this product. The local package cache [bun-docs-12] and `bun prune` [bun-docs-45] manage downloaded package artifacts and node_modules, not user data subject to privacy retention policies, so they are not credited here.
